items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: You did 'Big Stuff' No I don't even remember -- Billy Taylor on bass? . . . Were there other records that you remember making with Billie? ... Bill Springer in '46

ctx.x: Yeah, but rock and roll wasn't my thing, you know. I still played rhythm and blues and boogie woogies and things. I can play a little rock, you know. Cause I have a little bit of everything musically to play.
Getting back to Billie Holiday a little bit -- you did make a couple of recordings with Billie --
